title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes rates(date); rates(currency). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.
